summary: The registrant, Audax Credit BDC Inc., filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to report that its Board declared a $0.17 per share distribution on common stock, payable June 30, 2026 to holders of record June 29, 2026. This is a routine dividend declaration with no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return plan, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or forced management change. The filing carries no deal terms or special-situation mechanics. As a standard current report about an ordinary dividend, it does not constitute a special situation.
